## IMPL-UNITGREEN-001: the unit suite green on both lab hosts (BDPv4: 0 failed, 0 skipped)

Operator, 2026-10-19: "BDPv4 requires all unit tests be green." and "There should be ZERO platform specific UNIT tests.  If it depends on the environment, it's an integration test." Plan: `docs/plans/2026-10-19-unit-suite-green.md` (approved 14:50; amendments in sections 7 to 9, 11, 17 and 18; execution record in sections 10, 12 and 14 to 18; decisions in section 13).

Draft until hostile validation (Codex gpt-6-astra max) returns AGREE at 98/98. No done state is claimed: every new or changed criterion is unsatisfied and every TODO task is unchecked.

- `83417029`, `6b4295b7`: docs only (the plan as built, the code-head receipts, the 19:41 decisions).
- `49cfec92`: hostile validation round 1, findings F3 and F5 (one skip definition for both guards; interpolation holes kept as code).
- `b4ad42aa`: round 1 finding F2 (36 native-boundary and tracked-file cases move to Integration, assertions unchanged).
- `a94579db`: docs only (the round 1 receipts and record, the round 2 gate receipts).
- `45a3197c`: round 2 finding R2-F2. `UnitSuitePlatformScanner` reads Roslyn syntax trees instead of regex lines; the five central Roslyn pins move from 5.3.0 to 5.9.0 (operator: "Use the latest Roslyn tools!").
- `27c43bcc`: round 2 finding R2-F1. One repository-root locator, `tests/Shared/TestRepositoryRoot.cs`, refuses outside `Category=Integration` (operator: "Looks like an opportunity to DRY"); 34 locator copies delegate to it; the tests it refused, plus link-creating and host-state tests, move to Integration with assertions unchanged; Repl.Core.Tests and QBAgent.Tests join MigrationIntegrationTests.
- `538d0ccf`: the user-profile scan fix (operator: "Fix scans in PR 87 (Recommended)"; this PR carries the fix for `triage-report-b0e41c36f93c4c91b1bf2524eb579ef8`). `DirectoryTreeWalker` (QBrainAi.Services) serves the marker plugin-cache scan and the session-log history scan: no directory link or other reparse point is followed, and a directory whose listing throws an IO or access error is skipped. The 12 import-path tests are tagged Integration.
- `56d14d7c`: a race in the new hermetic-profile check, found by the pre-HV what-if pass, fixed.
- `6042dbb3`, `0210244d`, `68fa7b39`: the LocalDB flake (operator: "Fix the flake in PR 87 (Recommended)", then "Serialize SQL Server tests (Recommended)"): one LocalDB default with a 120 s connect timeout, and the four classes that open LocalDB in one collection defined with `DisableParallelization = true`.
- `6ea425ab`: the Windows lane's lost results (operator: "Diagnose the loss in PR 87"): pg_ctl start and stop run with `-s`, so pg_ctl no longer writes into the xUnit v3 message stream (see "Lost Windows lane results" below).
- `395b4cd8`, `6b89998f`, `64fc4b14`: docs only (the round 2 HV receipts, the round 3 gate receipts and plan record, the round 3 pre-launch records).
- `e0b078c8`: pre-HV problem R3-P3 (operator: "Fold R3-P3 in first"): a plugin version file that exists but cannot be read no longer fails the marker.
- `0996a116`: docs only, the hostile validation round 3 receipts as received.
- `801e6862`: round 3 findings R3-F1 and R3-F2 (operator: "Structural fix, round 4 (Recommended)"). One source seam, `AgentPluginVersionSources`, holds every input marker plugin-version resolution reads (the plugin-root variables, the workspace sibling folder, the profile caches); the unit-test assembly fixture installs test-owned sources and resolution tests pass explicit sources, so no unit test reads or changes the process environment for it. The Roslyn scanner resolves aliases and static imports in their lexical scope, within the limit declared below.
- `c31c2918`: docs only, round 3 finding R3-F4 (the round 3 self-review sentence corrected in both copies).
- `26fc8348`: the two red results at `801e6862`. `HandoffDurabilityTests` gives each context its own connection to one temporary database file (operator: "Fix the race in PR 87 (Recommended)"; `triage-report-9b96ada18d72483dad2a3113e455c01b`, closed by this PR); the process sources and sibling rule moved back into `MarkerFileService`, so the `Path.GetFullPath` ratchet (TR-MCP-FED-PATH-001) passes again.
- `50b58ce5`: docs only, the round 4 run receipts through `26fc8348`.
- `97b78114`: the siblings of the race class found by the pre-HV sweep, `HandoffAuditDefectTests` and `MemoryS1Harness`, get the same fix (operator: "Extend fix, then round 4 (Recommended)").
- `b0db5b09`, `094e47f4`: docs only (the plan's round 4 record, the receipts at `97b78114`, the round 4 pre-launch records; the round 4 HV receipts as received).
- `8c254695`: round 4 finding R4-F3. The memory harness binding cites FR-MCP-MEMORY-002, TR-MCP-MEMORY-002 and TEST-MCP-MEMORY-002, present and mapped, instead of TEST-MCP-MEMORY-010, which neither lab store holds. Documentation comment only.
- `ccc78b7a`: round 4 finding R4-F1, as the operator decided (see "Declared scanner limit"). The scanner's own documentation states the limit. Documentation comments only.
- `3a9f8ff4`, `5b818847`: docs only (the round 5 run receipts, plan section 18, the corrected round 4 copies, the console logs and the Windows dry-run receipt).
- `810ee8aa`: found by the widened hostile-environment gate (see below). `McpDatabaseEncryptionTransitionCommandTests.TryParse_UsesEnvironmentInstance_WhenCliInstanceIsOmitted` set only `MCP_INSTANCE` while `QBRAINAI_INSTANCE` wins, so it failed on a machine that sets `QBRAINAI_INSTANCE`. It is now `Category=Integration` (day-one rule) and clears `QBRAINAI_INSTANCE` for its duration; assertions unchanged; test-only. This is the last code, test or build change.
- Docs only after it: `8b7a49ea` (the widened-gate and fix-head receipts, plan section 18 to date) and `780b6513` (the round 5 prelaunch brief, self-review and the projected problems the operator confirmed). `git diff --name-only 810ee8aa..HEAD` lists only `docs/` paths.

### Gates at `810ee8aa`

- Linux Test `ug-r5-linux-test-3` (committed tree, before the push): 4517 total, 4517 passed, 0 failed, 0 not executed.
- Widened hostile-environment gate `ug-r5-hostile-wide-4` (about 90 scripted variables, see below): 4517 total, 4517 passed, 0 failed, 0 not executed.
- Windows Test `ug-r5-win-test-ssh-3` (PAYTON-LEGION2 over SSH as kingd, dry run first, HEAD verified): 4517 total, 4517 passed, 0 failed, 0 not executed; per project the same counts as Linux (Support.Mcp 3135, Repl.Core 865, Client 306, QBAgent 94, McpAgent 64, Cqrs 33, Launcher 20).
- Windows MigrationIntegrationTests from kingd's interactive desktop session `ug-r5-win-lane-3` (pinned gate runner; proof `session=1 interactive=True head=810ee8aa`; log line `Integration lane filter: Category=Integration&Platform!=Linux`): 374 passed (Support.Mcp 362, McpAgent 1, Repl.Core 3, QBAgent 2, Build.Tests 6), 0 failed, 0 not executed; by name the previous lane plus the moved test.
- Linux MigrationIntegrationTests `ug-r5-linux-lane-3`: 398 passed (Support.Mcp 376, McpAgent 1, Repl.Core 3, QBAgent 2, Build.Tests 16), 0 failed, 0 not executed; by name the previous lane plus the moved test.
- Full Build.Tests (raw `dotnet test`) `ug-r5-build-tests-3`, with TMPDIR on `/home`: 436 total, 436 passed, 0 failed, 0 not executed. Operator: "Rerun with temp on disk (Recommended)", after `ug-r5-build-tests-1` at `ccc78b7a` failed 1 of 436 on the `/tmp` user quota ("Disk quota exceeded"; nothing in `/tmp` was deleted). Operator: "Explicitly state that temporary files in official temporary folders are not a system change."
- ValidateTraceability `ug-r5-traceability-2`: passed. It reads the committed `docs/Project` exports (see "Information, not a gate").
- No receipt, so failed and not counted (operator: "No recipt is a fail."): `ug-r5-docfix-run-1`, the pre-commit full Test for `ccc78b7a` (its commit message cites the console counts; that citation does not count), and `ug-r5-linux-lane-1` at `8c254695`. Both started without a test-run id, so no TRX was written.
- History: at `ccc78b7a` every gate was green with receipts (4518 unit tests, lanes 373 and 397, Build.Tests 436 after the temp rerun); at `8c254695` the gates with receipts were green.
- Receipts: `docs/receipts/unit-suite-green-20261019/`.

### The widened hostile-environment gate

- Operator, 2026-10-21T07:23, on the gate's scope: "If it needs to be done, do it." The gate scripted only the five plugin-root variables and HOME. It now scripts every environment variable the 7 unit projects or the production code read by literal name, both forms of the 25 names production reads through `ProductEnvironment.GetLegacy` (`QBRAINAI_` wins over `MCP_`), and two configuration-shaped variables: about 90 in all, at hostile directories or scripted values (no real secret). PATH, TMPDIR, NUGET_PACKAGES and DOTNET_CLI_HOME stay real.
- Its first two runs at `5b818847` (code-identical to `ccc78b7a`), `ug-r5-hostile-wide-1` and `-2`, each failed exactly one unit test, the one fixed in `810ee8aa`; they are the gate's negative control. At `810ee8aa` it is 4517/0/0.

### Declared scanner limit

- Round 4 finding R4-F1 was the third scanner finding in a row (after R2-F2 and R3-F2). `UnitSuitePlatformScanner` resolves a using alias whose target names a type, and a `using static` that names a type, each in its lexical scope. It does not resolve an alias whose target is another alias (`using Host = OS;`), or a `using static` that names an alias.
- Operator, 2026-10-21T05:10:50: "Declare the limit, no fix". Operator, 05:43:12: "Correct the doc comments (Recommended)" (built in `ccc78b7a`) and "New TODO for the scanner".
- The scanner's behavior is unchanged since `801e6862`. No test file uses either form: the only `using static` lines in `tests/` are scripted scanner sources inside string literals, and the only alias with a single-name target, `using Abstractions = Xunit;`, names a namespace.
- TR-MCP-USECASE-018 AC-006 and TR-MCP-USECASE-019 AC-008 state the outcome (no unit test depends on the platform), not the scanner. Their evidence is the runs on both hosts and the hostile-environment gate. Operator, 2026-10-21T07:12:22: "It is a workspace rule, not something that needs to be mechanically enforced."
- The scanner alias work is TODO `IMPL-SCANNERALIAS-001` (section Build, depends on IMPL-UNITGREEN-001, TR-MCP-USECASE-018 and -019), an open record with no work scheduled.
- Operator, 2026-10-21T06:06:46: "I don't want any more scanner work.  None.  Add an operator override to the HV." Hostile validation round 5 carries that override: the scanner and every statement of its coverage are not scored, and no finding may require a scanner change. The outcome (no unit test depends on the platform) is still judged on the runs.

### Lost Windows lane results

- Lanes 1, 3 and 5 of round 3 each dropped 1 or 2 of the 361 Support.Mcp results without any outcome; total still equaled executed, so each run is compared by name with a complete one.
- Cause: xUnit v3 sends its messages as JSON lines on the test process's standard output, and the fixture's pg_ctl, run without output redirection, garbled them. Fixed in `6ea425ab` (`-s`); every lane since is complete by name. Triage `0f7839ef` records the cause.

### Hostile validation

- Round 1 (`unitgreen-r1`, HEAD `6b4295b7`): DISAGREE, 95/93, 5 PASS and 7 FAIL (F1 to F7). Plan section 14.
- Round 2 (`unitgreen-r2`, HEAD `a94579db`): DISAGREE, 96/94, 7 PASS and 6 FAIL (R2-F1 to R2-F3). Plan sections 15 and 16.
- Round 3 (`unitgreen-r3`, HEAD `64fc4b14`, last code head `e0b078c8`): DISAGREE, 97/96, 9 PASS and 8 FAIL (R3-F1 to R3-F4, all implementer edits). Receipts: `docs/receipts/hv/20261020T170824-unitgreen-r3.*` and `hostile-validator-unitgreen-r3-20261020T170824.*`; the full result is in reviewer turn `req-20261020T221024Z-unitgreen-r3`. Plan section 17.
- Round 4 (`unitgreen-r4`, HEAD `b0db5b09`, last code head `97b78114`): DISAGREE, 97/97, 10 PASS and 9 FAIL. Findings: R4-F1 (alias chains and static imports of an alias are not resolved; declared by the operator), R4-F2 (the round 4 brief kept a stale docs-only range and task count, and my self-review claimed the propagation was done; corrected with notices), and R4-F3 (a cited TEST absent from the store; fixed in `8c254695`). Receipts: `docs/receipts/hv/20261020T215217-unitgreen-r4.*` and `hostile-validator-unitgreen-r4-20261020T215217.*`; the full result is in reviewer turn `req-20261021T025534Z-unitgreen-r4`. Plan section 18.
- Round 5 (`unitgreen-r5`, HEAD `780b6513`, last code head `810ee8aa`): launched after the operator confirmed the projected problems at 2026-10-21T11:13:18; the brief carries the operator override of the scanner and puts Azure-related errors out of scope.

### Requirements

- TR-MCP-NUKE-019 created under FR-MCP-BUILD-001 (AC-1 to AC-5).
- FR-MCP-USECASE-016 and -017 converted into TR-MCP-USECASE-018 and -019 under FR-MCP-USECASE-001 and deleted; FR-MCP-USECASE-017 read back as present in round 3 and was deleted again through the plugin; the getter and the effective view show neither (rechecked 18:58 to 18:59).
- TR-MCP-QUALITY-001 ac-21 reopened and strengthened; TEST-MCP-PATHNORM-001 gained `unitgreen-native-host`.
- AC-TR-MCP-WS-005-001 (strengthened for R3-P3 at 16:32 and replaced for R3-F1 at 18:23:07: unit tests take every plugin-version input from test-owned data, and a full unit run under a hostile environment stays 0 failed) and AC-TR-MCP-SESSIONLOG-006-009, both unsatisfied.
- No requirement or criterion changed in round 5.
- After AGREE, these are set satisfied (plan section 13, D-B): TR-MCP-NUKE-019 AC-1 to AC-5, TR-MCP-USECASE-018 AC-006, TR-MCP-USECASE-019 AC-008, TR-MCP-QUALITY-001 ac-21, TEST-MCP-PATHNORM-001 `unitgreen-native-host`, AC-TR-MCP-WS-005-001 and AC-TR-MCP-SESSIONLOG-006-009. The other 17 USECASE criteria stay unsatisfied. All 21 tasks of IMPL-UNITGREEN-001 are checked and it is marked done; IMPL-SCANNERALIAS-001 stays open.

### Open

- The scanner alias limit (above), recorded in TODO IMPL-SCANNERALIAS-001; no scanner work is planned (operator override).
- This store holds 1 criterion for TR-MCP-SESSIONLOG-006 where the committed export lists 8 (`triage-report-647e35bbdf9e43f5a8752cfc32f6c7a4`).

### Information, not a gate

- Operator, 2026-10-21T06:54:47: "Azure is no longer in the picture.  Create a global memory not to gate on azure related errors." (global MCP memory MEMORY-PROCESS-009). The requirements wiki export fails on its Azure-specific cleanup path, "azure/Architecture" (`triage-report-a6927fca10364155ab9992506e1abc9c`, retried 2026-10-21T06:53:31), so the generated `docs/Project` exports stay as committed and do not show the round 3 and round 4 criteria. That is recorded here and is not a gate.
- Risk, flagged (operator: "Then flag the risk and roll on."): the race cause is an inference; the harness check proves the shared-connection condition and its removal, but a scheduling race cannot be reproduced on demand by a unit test.
- Behavior change, declared: a directory link or other reparse point below a scanned profile root is no longer followed by either scan.
- Declared, not part of this PR: a test tagged with both Platform values, or an unknown one, has no stated outcome (none exists); Build.Tests, the Validation projects and the IntegrationTests projects keep their own repository walk-ups.
- Route: Windows evidence runs over SSH as kingd (operator 2026-10-20), by IP 10.42.0.143.
- Hostile validation round 5.
